S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.

subtypes.Chronic Worry: Worry occurs more days than not for at least 6 months.
subtypes.Generalized Worry: Worry is not confined to specific topics but spreads to various domains like work, school, family, and finances.
subtypes.Catastrophizing: Jumping to conclusions that minor mistakes or events will lead to irreversible disasters.
subtypes.Intolerance of Uncertainty: Unable to tolerate future uncertainty, trapped in 'what if' questions.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.

subtypes.Failure to Control: Unable to regulate worry despite efforts to stop or distract oneself.
subtypes.Intrusive Worry: Worries suddenly intrude into the mind and interfere with focus while doing other tasks.
subtypes.Chaining of Worry: One worry triggers another in a chain reaction, escalating to catastrophic thoughts.

S059.name: Concentration_Difficulty
S059.description: Difficulty concentrating or mind going blank.

subtypes.Interference by Worry: Unable to focus on the task at hand because worries keep surfacing.
subtypes.Inability to Sustain Attention: Attention is scattered due to anxiety, making it hard to focus on one thing for long.
subtypes.Mind Going Blank: Suddenly the mind goes empty or white, and no thoughts occur.

S061.name: Muscle_Tension
S061.description: A state where muscles are continuously tense, stiff, and accompanied by discomfort.

subtypes.Neck and Shoulder Tension: Muscles in the shoulders and back of the neck are knotted and stiff, causing pain or headaches.
subtypes.Jaw Tension: Clenching teeth or tension in the jaw causing jaw pain or headaches.
subtypes.Generalized Muscle Aches: Muscles all over the body, including back, arms, and legs, are stiff, painful, and easily fatigued.
subtypes.Chronic Stiffness: Muscles remain in a constant state of tension and do not relax.

symptom.disease_info: Generalized Anxiety Disorder is characterized by persistent, excessive worry about multiple areas of life that is difficult to control, lasts for months, and is accompanied by physical and cognitive tension such as sleep disturbance, concentration difficulty, and muscle tightness. It typically has a gradual course and becomes clinically significant when the worry extends beyond a specific stressor, impairs functioning, and is not better explained by episodic panic, trauma re-experiencing, mood episodes, or a circumscribed phobia.

patient.stressor: Parin decided to sell her longtime house and move into a smaller Bowling Green condo, partly to reduce upkeep and partly to be closer to her brokerage office, art events, and South Asian community activities. The move was practical and self-directed, but it unsettled the routines that had anchored her—gardening, cooking, watercolor work, and the familiar home office where she had managed real-estate contracts for years. Over the following 1 year and 2 months, her worry gradually became broader and harder to contain, centering on market shifts, client deadlines, condo finances, family expectations, and whether downsizing had been a mistake; sleep quality declined, muscle tension accumulated, and concentration during contract review became less reliable. She sought psychiatric care on her own after noticing that even modest listing negotiations were taking twice as long because she kept rereading documents and losing her train of thought.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: Most nights I get into bed at a reasonable hour, but my mind keeps circling through condo fees, tomorrow’s showings, and whether I missed something in a contract, so it takes me a long time to settle and I wake up feeling like I never fully rested.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.
S056.manifestation: I came in because I seem to worry about everything now—clients, the market, my family, money, even whether moving to the condo was the right decision—and it feels out of proportion to what is actually happening.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.
S057.manifestation: Even when I tell myself, 'Parin, this is not urgent,' one concern leads to another, and before I know it I’ve spent half an hour replaying small details I meant to let go.

S059.name: Concentration_Difficulty
S059.description: Difficulty concentrating or mind going blank.
S059.manifestation: When I’m reviewing purchase agreements or inspection addendums, I’ll read the same paragraph three or four times because a worry pops in and I lose the thread of what I was checking.

S061.name: Muscle_Tension
S061.description: A state where muscles are continuously tense, stiff, and accompanied by discomfort.
S061.manifestation: By the end of the day my neck and shoulders feel tight like I’ve been bracing myself, and sometimes I catch myself clenching my jaw while I’m driving between listings or sitting at my desk.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: At work, even straightforward listing negotiations and contract reviews are taking me much longer than they used to, and I’ve had to delay returning calls because I don’t feel confident I’ve checked everything carefully enough.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about a year and two months, since after I sold my longtime house and moved into the condo.
